name: autofte
description: AutoFTE — an auto-export platform (website, CRM, auction, chat, app) run by Sora, a Digital FTE built with Muse Spark Open.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/server && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
